blocks.text: Retrosynthesis bilkul synthesis ka ulat hai. Is mein target molecule ko kam pecheeda (less complicated), saada aur aasani se milne wale compounds mein toora jata hai jo starting material ban sakein. Retrosynthesis disconnection approach (bond ko kaghaz par torne ka tareeqa) istemal karti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf Target Molecule aur daen taraf Starting Material, darmiyan do khule retrosynthetic teer starting material ki taraf. Oopar magenta chakkar 'Retrosynthesis' target molecule se starting material tak jata hai; neeche cyan chakkar 'Synthesis' starting material se wapas target molecule tak aata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.1: Synthesis aur retrosynthesis ke raaste (routes) (kitab ki Figure 25.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wala teer retrosynthesis hai: target molecule se peeche ki taraf starting material tak. Neeche wala teer synthesis hai: starting material se aage target molecule tak. Beech ke khule teer (⇒) retrosynthetic arrows hain.

Retrosynthesis mein target molecule ke woh bonds tore jate hain jin se structure kaafi had tak saada ho jaye. Aise kai disconnections ke baad hum aakhir kaar saada aur aasani se milne wale starting materials tak pohanch jate hain.
Retrosynthesis mein istemal hone wali saada istilahat (terms)

items: Retrosynthetic arrow aik khule sire wala (open-ended) teer hai, jise ⇒ se dikhate hain. Is ka matlab hai: "yeh is se ban sakta hai".
Target Molecule (TM) woh molecule hai jise banana hai; retrosynthesis mein isi ko disconnection se toora jata hai.
Disconnection woh amal hai jis mein TM ko kaghaz par, khayali tor par (imaginary), qadam ba qadam saada starting materials mein toora jata hai.
Synthons target molecule ke woh tukre (fragments) hain jo disconnection se bante hain. Yeh aksar ions hote hain aur synthesis ke building blocks (bunyadi tukre) hain.
Synthetic Equivalent (SE) woh asal reagent hai jo synthon ka kaam karta hai, kyun ke synthon aam tor par unstable (na-paidar) hota hai aur khud istemal nahi ho sakta.
Functional Group Interconversion (FGI) target molecule tak pohanchne ke liye aik functional group ko doosre mein badalna hai.
Retrosynthetic Tree aik diagram hai jo target molecule se starting materials tak tamam mumkin disconnections aur synthons dikhata hai.

blocks.text: Figure 25.2 yeh sab istilahat aik hi scheme mein dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Aniline (NH2 wala benzene ring), 'Target Molecule (TM)', khule teer 'FGI' se nitrobenzene tak, jis ke C-N bond par lehredaar katt (slash) hai. Cyan khula teer 'Disconnection' do teeron mein batt jata hai: oopar synthon (A), manfi charge wala benzene ring, jo benzene (SE) ke barabar hai; neeche synthon (B), musbat charge wala NO2, jo HNO3, nitric acid (SE) ke barabar hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.2: Retrosynthesis mein istemal hone wali istilahat (terms) (kitab ki Figure 25.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Aniline (TM) par NH₂ seedha nahi lagaya ja sakta, is liye pehle FGI se NH₂ ko NO₂ samjha jata hai. Phir C–N bond par lehredaar (wavy) nishan ka matlab hai ke yahan bond kaghaz par toora gaya. Is se do synthons milte hain: manfi charge wala phenyl ion (A) aur musbat NO₂⁺ (B). Yeh khud stable nahi, is liye teen lakeeron wala nishan (≡, equivalent) un ke asal reagents batata hai: benzene aur nitric acid (SE).

blocks.prompt: Synthon aur synthetic equivalent mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Synthon disconnection se milne wala khayali tukra hai (aksar ion), jo khud istemal nahi ho sakta. Synthetic equivalent woh asal, stable reagent hai jo lab mein us synthon ka kaam karta hai; maslan C₆H₅⁻ ke liye benzene aur NO₂⁺ ke liye HNO₃.

items: Retrosynthesis: TM ⇒ disconnections ⇒ saada starting materials.
Synthons khayali tukre hain; synthetic equivalents asal reagents.
FGI aik group ko doosre mein badal kar disconnection aasan banata hai.
